comment: Desktop's transform (src/main/formatter/transform.ts) over these inputs, for every platform to give the same answers (ios/prd.json IOS-024): the messages for an instruction and a selection, the verdict on a model's reply, and whole calls to a connection at baseUrl https://edit.example/v1/ with model edit-model, where sent is the request made (null when none was) and result the outcome. A run with selectionLength sends that many letter a's; failure network or timeout means the request never got an answer.
